title: Naked Singularities beyond Spherical Symmetry: Instability of $κ$-Self-Similar Solutions via an Iteration Scheme
summary: This paper provides the instability counterpart to our recent construction of nonspherically symmetric approximating $κ$-self-similar naked-singularity solutions for the Einstein--scalar field system. These singular solutions contain pervasive nonspherical borderline terms, and to prove instability the delicate renormalization procedure developed in [2] does not extend to the more singular setting considered here.
